column1: # Papilio ESP Bootloader partition table — 4 MB flash
# Three-slot layout: an always-present `factory` partition (the loader itself)
# plus `ota_0`/`ota_1` for the user app (e.g. FPGA-Companion)
# always be reached/recovered independent of what's flashed into the app slots.
# See papilio-works/plans/2026-09-21-papilio-esp-bootloader.md for the full design.
# Flash layout (4 MB = 0x400000 bytes):
#   0x000000  Bootloader (ESP-IDF second-stage)
#   0x008000  Partition table
#   0x009000  nvs_loader   (12 KB)  — loader's OWN WiFi creds
#   0x00C000  otadata      (8 KB)   — blank/invalid => bootloader falls back to `factory`
#   0x00E000  nvs          (24 KB)  — user app's own NVS (settings
#   0x020000  factory      (896 KB) — Papilio ESP Bootloader (this repo)
#   0x100000  ota_0        (1.5 MB) — user app slot 1 (e.g. FPGA-Companion)
#   0x280000  ota_1        (1.5 MB) — user app slot 2 (rollback safety net)
#   0x400000  end of flash
# App partition offsets are left blank so gen_esp32part.py auto-aligns them to
# the required 0x10000 (64 KB) boundary — the 0x14000-0x20000 gap after `nvs`
# is unavoidable padding from that alignment rule
column2: not wasted space we can claim.
